description: This file defines React components for route protection based on authentication and user roles within a React application, utilizing react-router-dom for navigation and context for authentication state management.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute()
methods.description: A React component that checks if the user is authenticated and either renders the nested routes or redirects to login.

methods.name: RoleRoute({ allowedRoles })
methods.description: A React component that checks if the user has the appropriate role for the route and either renders the nested routes or redirects accordingly.
